ana (sec-eng): FYI Splunk alert — KMS logship into S3 started failing right after yesterday's RBAC prune. Seeing 403s from the logship role.

sam (runtime): Which env? prod/dedicated or staging?

ana (sec-eng): prod cluster-a. Triggered ~22:12 UTC. Looks like the kms-logship role cannot PutObject.

jordan (infra): I was the one who tightened policies last night. Can you paste the error?

ana (sec-eng): ```
2026-03-20T22:12:03Z ERROR: PutObjectDenied: s3://redwood-kms-logs/v1/.... status 403: AccessDenied
AssumedRole arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/kms-logship-prod/i-abc123
Principal: arn:aws:iam::111111:role/kms-logship-prod
```

kelsey (compliance): Compliance note — do NOT change anything irreversible until we snapshot the audit trail. We need the KMS key policy and bucket acl captured.

sam (runtime): Quick hypothesis: the IAM change removed s3:PutObject from the role and we relied on a bucket policy that no longer references the role. jordan, did you remove a bucket policy grant?

jordan (infra): I removed the old wide PutObject grant on the role in favor of a tighter bucket policy, but looks like I forgot to add the specific principal to the new bucket policy. Reapplying now.

ana (sec-eng): Also noticed the KMS re-wrap during rotation failed for some objects in the same window — so some telemetry missed. We should plan a backfill for the 21:50-22:30 window.

audit-bot: key-rotation job finished: key-rotation/run-2026-03-20T21:00:00Z -> status=success; wrapper job at 22:10 returned error code=403 on PutObject.

sam (runtime): I can run the backfill once the bucket write perms are restored. Who owns the wrap/re-encrypt script?

jordan (infra): Pushing bucket policy change now — diff below: 
```
+ {
+   "Effect": "Allow",
+   "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111111:role/kms-logship-prod"},
+   "Action": "s3:PutObject",
+   "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-kms-logs/*"
+ }
```

deploy-bot: bucket policy change applied in acct 111111 by jordan at 2026-03-20T22:19:12Z

ana (sec-eng): Tentative fix confirmed — Splunk ingestion resumed :thumbsup:. Next steps: short RCA + remediation list. Initial items: 1) RBAC rollback process lacks a checklist tied to integrations; 2) no CI smoke test for logship S3 write path; 3) missing canary for KMS re-wrap failures.

kelsey (compliance): Add to checklist: require capture of KMS key policy and the explicit principals allowed to write logs before any RBAC tightening. Also request an alert on log ingestion rate drop.

sam (runtime): I'll open a follow-up ticket (sec-ops#4521) to add CI smoke, canary, and an automation that verifies bucket principal grants post-change. Also need to triage container image vulns for logship: I saw an OpenSSL CVE-2026-XXXX flagged in the current image.

ana (sec-eng): I uploaded the list of affected images and manifests: https://redwood.app/drive/driveid/kms-logship-images (contains image ids + digest + CVE scan). Do not rebuild images without cosign sigs and an approval from compliance.

jordan (infra): Agreed — will hold any base image rebuilds until key rotation backfill and ingestion stability confirmed. ETA for holding window: ~2h.

kelsey (compliance): Also added: require KMS principals enumeration in PR description and a smoke canary that performs a PutObject as the logship role. Add cosign verification to the rebuild pipeline.

ana (sec-eng): Incident created: KMS-LOGSHIP-20260320 (tagging for follow-up). Please add timeline entries to the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident KMS-LOGSHIP-20260320 created by ana at 2026-03-20T22:20:01Z — severity=P2, affected=log ingestion to splunk, mitigation=in-flight

sam (runtime): I'll coordinate the backfill run and the image rebuild checklist. Will post updates in sec-ops#4521 and link here.

ana (sec-eng): Thanks everyone. Quick wins: (a) add bucket principal smoke to preflight; (b) add log-rate alert; (c) add KMS principal enumerator to RBAC change playbook. Longer term: add integration test that runs as part of RBAC changes.

kelsey (compliance): Adding the compliance action items to the quarterly audit list as well.

jordan (infra): Confirmed fix remains stable for 15m. Holding off on any further RBAC prunes until we have the smoke in CI.

ana (sec-eng): Closing loop here — will draft the RCA and rota notes and ping infra for the backfill window.

(End of thread)
